summary: {person} tests a restored bus against a transfer instead of counting the route as restored in full.
realLife: Milwaukee’s summer Route 28 schedule offered midday buses every forty minutes and peak buses every thirty minutes on weekdays.
gates: A restored service runs at different intervals across the day.
weights: A tightly timed connection makes the difference between peak and midday service matter.
inGame: needs: time of travel, headways by time of day and connection departure.

turns.what: The planner verifies the return trip separately.
turns.pulledBy: The midday bus makes the connection.
turns.writesBack: Save the usable pair of trips.

turns.what: The rider asks which trip must move to restore it.
turns.pulledBy: The slower interval breaks the connection.
turns.writesBack: Register the transfer problem against the timetable.
